title: Standards export
purpose: Create traceable WHONET, FHIR, HL7 and analysis files from a clearly filtered local cohort.
noLabMessage: Exports require an explicit source laboratory.
noLabHelp: Choose a site to create an export.
cohortDescription: Leave dates blank for all available records at the active laboratory.

whonet.title: WHONET
whonet.description: WHONET-compatible isolate/AST table for established AMR workflows.

fhir.title: FHIR R4 Bundle
fhir.description: Standards-coded diagnostic report and observation resources.

hl7.title: HL7 v2.5.1
hl7.description: ORU-style pipe-delimited laboratory messages with OBX interpretation.

measure.title: FHIR MeasureReport
measure.description: Aggregate surveillance measures suitable for federated reporting.

csv.title: Analysis CSV
csv.description: Flat, analysis-ready export of the filtered local cohort.

safeguards.title: Interoperability safeguards
safeguards.codedBody: Organism, specimen and antibiotic codes remain attached where the target format supports them.
safeguards.astBody: Structured exports retain detailed AST fields; WHONET CSV emits result and measurement columns.
safeguards.cohortBody: Laboratory and date filters are audited with the export.

help.formats: WHONET, FHIR R4 and HL7 v2.5.1 formats support different consumers. Validate exported files in the receiving system before operational exchange.
help.aggregate: MeasureReport is aggregate-oriented. Row-level exports should be shared only under an authorised data-governance process.
